prompt: This service sits directly in front of our primary Postgres database and backs a read-heavy endpoint — reads outnumber writes roughly 10 to 1, and the same handful of hot profile IDs get re-fetched constantly. At peak traffic the database has become the bottleneck: read P99 latency is climbing and DB QPS is close to saturation, even though most of these reads return identical, barely-changing data. Walk me through how you'd optimize this read path, and what new costs or failure modes that optimization introduces.
